games.title: Reading Detective

rounds.prompt: Why did the soldiers stop the old farmer’s funeral?
choices: The soldiers said no gatherings were allowed and that the funeral was a prohibited event, because every event now had to be approved first.
They clean the environment by eating dead animals, which helps stop disease from spreading and keeps the food web healthy.
Amal says injustice is like typhoid — you do not always see it, but it poisons everything — comparing the hidden illness in the water to the hidden harm of unfair rule.
rounds.answer: The soldiers said no gatherings were allowed and that the funeral was a prohibited event, because every event now had to be approved first.
rounds.explanation: In the story the soldiers declare the funeral a prohibited event and insist that all events, even grief, must follow their rules.

rounds.prompt: What reason did the soldiers give for burning the school books?

rounds.explanation: In part two the soldiers call the books propaganda and burn several, telling the villagers to learn only what is permitted.
